walkthroughs.body_html:
Literature and Film Study — a core area of A-Level Spanish.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Literature and Film Study brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Literature and Film Study.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I used the computer today'? (Spain Spanish)

Accents are random in Spanish.

mcqs.q: Why does 'qué' have an accent in '¿Qué quieres?' but not always elsewhere?
options: The accent distinguishes interrogative/exclamative 'qué' from relative 'que'.
Estoy usando el ordenador hoy.
It is a mistake.
Accents are random in Spanish.
